listing.name: Starsector HORRIBLE WEAPONS pack which contains 2 new ships, 1 fighter and 1 new weapon wing to be used by Core World factions
listing.summary: Adds new ships, weapons, and fighter wings with unique mechanics and enhanced capabilities.
listing.aiSummary: Adds new ships, weapons, and fighter wings with unique mechanics and enhanced capabilities.

description: Adds new ships such as the Mithrill Midline Battleship and Hellrose kinetic DEM, along with the Tri-Tachyon Enforcer and Cactus Fighter Wing. Introduces new weapon systems and variants that significantly alter combat dynamics. Designed to be used by Core World factions, these additions expand the strategic depth and variety of fleet composition.
